calibration_scope: Monotone logistic calibration is fitted only on disjoint synthetic reference draws after its regularization is selected inside the calibration-development partition. It is not empirical WetLinks calibration and does not calibrate a field service-survival probability.
claim_boundary: Controlled synthetic mechanism ablation over one generated EOS-Bench scenario. Seeds are stochastic replications, not independent campaigns, operators or sites.
congestion_selection_scope: The congestion penalty is selected separately within each condition on synthetic tuning seeds that are disjoint from every reported evaluation seed.
matched_design: Within each condition/seed/task, all six arms share the EOS geometry, synthetic telemetry, forecast-feasible actions, resource constraints and hash-keyed potential outcomes. Every arm uses EDF task order.

normalized_field_semantics.action_installed: True exactly when an action was selected and the synthetic installation step did not fail. It does not imply acquisition, byte delivery or task completion.
normalized_field_semantics.action_selected: True exactly when the scheduler returns a non-null selected_path_id before installation and outcome realization.
normalized_field_semantics.baseline_fallback: True only if a non-baseline arm substitutes the EDF-current-SNR baseline after its own candidate is unauthorized. It is always False in v3 because screened arms abstain rather than fall back.
normalized_field_semantics.evidence_type: Evidence provenance for the row; always synthetic_simulation in this experiment.
normalized_field_semantics.input_eligible: True exactly when the candidate has full gate-feature coverage and zero out-of-domain fraction under the frozen synthetic Mahalanobis input screen. It does not imply geometry, storage, capacity, policy or field eligibility.
normalized_field_semantics.policy_authorized: True exactly when an action was selected and that action satisfies the arm's declared simulation eligibility rule. Unscreened arms accept any resource-feasible selected action; screened arms additionally require input_eligible=True. This is simulation-scope authorization and is never field-release authorization.

predictor_scope: Logistic coefficients and regularization are estimated only from synthetic predictor-development draws. The C value is selected on an internal disjoint development fold and the final model is refitted before calibration. No hand-set hazard or reliability coefficients enter the fitted score.

wetlinks_feature_units.download_mbps: megabits per second over five-minute bin
wetlinks_feature_units.upload_mbps: megabits per second over five-minute bin

wetlinks_nonapplication_reason: The EOS overlay supplies RF SNR, forecast rate, jitter, handover probability and profile outage probability. The fitted WetLinks survival model requires a 16-field five-minute transport/weather vector and predicts sustained QoS survival on a different time grid. No validated feature, unit or horizon adapter exists; applying it here would not be a valid model evaluation.
